title: Graphical Characterization of Interventional Data Subject to Selection before Perturbation
banked_reason: The unconditional result is confined to a purely graphical fixed-A fiber and does not identify the canonical unknown-A SI-PAG; faithful realization and the observable complete rule list remain open.
gap_reasons: The unconditional result is confined to a purely graphical fixed-A fiber and, within it, to intervention-created adjacencies whose endpoints lie in the latent selected-ancestry set; it does not identify the canonical unknown-A SI-PAG.

The proposed fixed, observable complete SI-PAG calculus with faithful opposing witnesses is replaced by a conditional implication that assumes both universal faithful realization and the unknown-A opposing-extension property; no rule list, canonical equality, or confidence SI-PAG result is delivered.

The ExactID target remains an endpointwise universal quantification over the compatibility fiber: the core supplies neither an instantiated finite rule system nor another computable recovery map from the oracle signature, while expressly leaving that construction open.
proof_attempt_summary: The run first pursued the full deterministic calculus plus a confidence SI-PAG rung, but the statistical angle exhausted its revision cap on a recurring pooled-versus-armwise positivity mismatch. A fresh deterministic angle proved and source-attested an exact graphical fixed-A frontier, separated it from the faithful-law bracket, and reduced simultaneous faithfulness to a conditional determinant argument without assuming the missing construction. The field claim still requires an explicit coupled faithful realization for both opposing replacements and a fixed observable unknown-A rule system; both remain open research barriers, so the sound package reaches only the incremental tier.
tldr: Selection before perturbation couples every pooled regime through one basal selected DAG and one shared-response twin SCM. The proved structural result is the exact fixed-\(A\) graphical identity \(\mathcal M_A^{\mathrm{gr}}=\mathcal G_A\). At law level, the faithful mark set is nonempty and contained in that graphical set, so singleton graphical sets give equality automatically; two-mark faithful witnesses require nonempty realization fibers. For a directly coupled nonempty open rational parameter family supplied as an additional premise, simultaneous pooled faithfulness within that family is equivalent to atomic determinant nontriviality; neither the family nor the certificates are constructed here. Constructing the parameter family, proving the atomic certificates, finding a finite observable unknown-\(A\) extension, and establishing canonical endpoint equality remain open. The achieved result is therefore below a complete-calculus result. Neither faithful realization nor the unknown-\(A\) extension follows from graphical inclusion.
gap: Dai et al., Theorem 3 and p. 8, lines 646--662, prove CDIS soundness and explicitly leave completeness uncertain because complete rules for their Lemma 6 background knowledge are unavailable. Their Lemmas 4--6 on pp. 6--7 supply the fixed-model semantic inputs but not opposing common-basal representatives. Zhang, Sections 3--4 and Theorem 2, proves arrowhead and tail completeness for one observational PAG without joint regime realizability. The Zhou--Kocaoglu author listing at lines 27--31 and public abstract at lines 5--9 describe an enumeration-based completion in a known-target setting; official theorem numbering and text were inaccessible, so no formula-level claim is used.
fill: The project combines full regime-MAG adjacency and unshielded-collider signatures with observable selectedness certificates, signature-monotone path propagation, graph replacement, and simultaneous faithful-kernel realization. It proves the fixed-\(A(\eta)\) endpoint frontier, solves the unknown-selection lifting problem, derives a complete fixed local calculus, and obtains conditional polynomial saturation without enumerating compatible basal DAGs.
